text:
arya: Final coordination for next Wed announce. Need changelog link, docs preview with runnable snippets, exact canary windows, and HubSpot tag/routing by EOD. Embargo 14:00 UTC. Can eng confirm rollout plan? @samir
samir: On it. Proposed ramp: 2% x 10m -> 15% x 20m -> 50% x 25m -> 100% after checks. Abort if 5xx > 0.7% or p95 > 320ms. Posting playbook link in 20m.
nora: Docs preview ready: https://docs.redwood.ai/previews/201. Includes curl + node quickstarts and a migration note. Will swap the model name after final confirm.
arya: Marketing will pull preview for blog + webinar deck. Need changelog commit hash to link release notes.
samir: Draft changelog: https://github.com/redwood-inference/changelog/commit/pqr789. Blurb: "Adaptive prefix caching + smarter batching to reduce tail latency and lower token cost for long-context workloads." Use that line for the blog.
jamie: For inbound, use HubSpot tag `launch_spring`. Routing: tag -> marketing/sdr queue; escalate to sales if usage>100 reqs/day or trial created within 24h. I'll paste rule IDs after this thread.
arya: Social plan: blog T+0, short thread +10, demo clip + webinar CTA +45. Webinar landing: https://redwood.ai/webinar/scale. Put reg link in blog CTA.
nora: Added CTA placeholder and live curl example. Will update model param to `rwd-serve-v3` once samir confirms.
samir: Confirm model `rwd-serve-v3`. APAC staged 1h after full rollout. I'll schedule a 15m dry-run at T-30m for go/no-go and demo rehearse. Checklist: canary health, error list, latency histograms, rollback steps.
infra-bot: [deploy-schedule] canary requested by samir for 2026-09-15T13:00:00Z
arya: Can we get a 1-line eng quote for the blog header? Samir?
samir: "This release improves tail latency and reduces token cost for long-context inference by combining adaptive prefix caching with smarter batching." Use as-is.
arya: Perfect. I'll lock the blog once changelog hash and docs permalink are pasted. Will schedule T-30m embargo ping in #marketing. :rocket:
